description: The fields we read from insurance documents, as a JSON Schema: to pick fields, or to write the person's schema against ours. It is long, so with no argument you get an index: each top-level part and its field count. parts returns those parts in full; search returns the field paths (with type and description) that match a word; all returns the whole schema.

parts.description: Top-level parts to return in full, from the index, e.g. ["vehicles", "policies"].

search.description: A word to find in field names, titles and descriptions, e.g. "premium". With parts, only within them.

name: get_standard_schema
title: Our standard schema
